name: Octree Insertion with Growth
definition: The complete process to insert a voxel into an Octree, including handling boundary conditions by growing the tree if necessary.
summary: Octree Insertion with Growth is a dynamic Sparse Voxel Octree construction method that recursively inserts voxels and expands the tree's spatial extent on-the-fly to handle out-of-bounds coordinates without pre-calculating the scene's bounding box.
